title: lquery level with enough OR-variants wraps a uint16 totallen, ~65 KB -- leaves its block
live_proof: upstream 8c34261109, "ltree: Fix overflows with lquery parsing", absent at the 17.5 pin. Upstream: a single lquery level with many OR-separated variants overflows totallen, which is a uint16, because each variant contributes MAXALIGN(LVAR_HDRSIZE + len); once it wraps, the data written by LQL_NEXT() is corrupt and the access goes out of bounds. The trigger here is 66 variants of 1000 characters, about 66 KB against a uint16 ceiling of 65535. Independently established on the pin by host ASan (heap-buffer-overflow in the lquery path) and by the purecap arm, which raises SIGPROT on both builds.
fidelity: real server, real allocator, in a contrib extension rather than core. ~65 KB, so it leaves its block
